title: CRLR/70/2012 of RAVINDRA PANT Vs HIRDESH DIPALI

paras.text:
MCRC No. 492 of 2012
CRMA No. 738 of 2012
CRLR No. 70 of 2012
Hon'ble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
Mr. Mr. H.S. Dhillon, Advocate, present
for the revisionist.
 Heard.
 This is Delay Condonation Application
No. 738 of 2012, for condonation of delay in
moving the recall/review application MCRC
No. 492 of 2012.
 Delay in filing the application is allowed.
Delay is condoned.
 Also heard on MCRC Recall Application
No. 492 of 2012.
 Learned counsel for the revisionist has
pleaded that the order dated 23.04.2012, passed
by this Court dismissing the revision as
withdrawn be recalled, as the counsel for the
revisionist could not seek instruction from the
revisionist and he had no instruction to
withdraw the revision.
 Having heard learned counsel for the
revisionist, and after going through the order
dated 23.04.2012, sought to be recalled and
further considering the order dated 24.02.2012,
passed by the Sessions Judge, Almora, in
Criminal Appeal No. 25 of 2010, whereby the
conviction of the revisionist Ravindra Pant was
affirmed under Section 500 and 501 of I.P.C.,
and he was sentenced to pay fine of Rs. 500/-
only on each count, this Court is of the view
that there is no sufficient reason to recall the
order dated 23.04.2012.
 Accordingly, the MCRC Recall
Application No. 492 of 2012, is dismissed.
(Prafulla C. Pant, J.)
29.06.2012
JM
